input.brief: One person in Romania scans rooms with an iPhone LiDAR sensor and delivers a measured floor plan plus a browser 3D model where furniture and real products are placed at real size before anyone buys or builds; for interior designers, kitchen and wardrobe makers, renovation contractors, real-estate agents, then homeowners

direction.name: The name as a monument
direction.idea: The name is the headline. Set it so large that it becomes architecture: as wide as the viewport, cropped by an edge, or stacked to fill the screen. Nothing else on the first screen competes; the description of what this is drops to a single small sentence. The idea comes from treating the name's letters as material. Ask what the subject can do to its own name: a photograph of the work sits inside a counter or replaces a letter, the name repeats down the page like a reel, the letters are split to opposite corners and the page happens between them. In the study this was the single most common device among sites scoring 7.5 or more.
direction.composition: First screen: the wordmark spans 88–100% of the viewport width (font-size 16–24vw, set with a clamp so it never wraps), anchored either to the bottom edge with its descenders nearly touching it, or dead centre with everything else pushed to the corners. One line of supporting text at 16–20px sits in a corner on a shared margin; navigation is three or four words in the opposite corner. After the hero the page is deliberately small and calm: a narrow text column or a simple two-column grid, so the contrast with the monument holds. The name returns once more at full width as the footer, in the inverse colours. Margins are tight (20–32px) so the type reaches the edges. Two type sizes do nearly all the work: the monument and a small text size, with one mid size for section headings.
direction.typography: One family. The display cut must survive enormous sizes: tight tracking (-0.04 to -0.07em), leading 0.8–0.9, optical kerning on. Section headings are modest (28–40px) on purpose.
direction.colour: Two values carry the page (ground and ink). The accent, if used at all, appears on one thing only: the single action or the inset image frame. The footer inverts ground and ink.
direction.imagery: Few images, used as inserts in the typography rather than as illustrations beside it: one photograph inside or behind the name (a 4:5 or 1:1 frame replacing a letter, or tucked between two words), then a short run of large full-width or half-width photographs further down. Square corners. No collage of small thumbnails.
direction.richness: Scale. The size of the name against the smallness of everything else is the entire visual event, so protect both ends: do not shrink the name to make room, and do not let body text creep above 20px.
direction.pitfalls: A long name set small is just a logo. If the name has more than about 12 characters, stack it on two lines or crop it with the viewport edge; never drop below 12vw. Do not add a second big headline under the name. Do not decorate the letters.

hero.name: Inset photograph, crossing wordmark
hero.blueprint: One deep, dark flat field. A tall portrait photograph fills the left 47% of the viewport, inset 20px from the top, left and bottom edges, with a 12px radius and object-fit: cover; it is position: sticky for the length of the page while the right side scrolls. Five text links at 15px sit top-right on a 32px margin, the last of them the single action. There is no logo at the top. In the right half, at 44% of the height and centred on that half's own axis, one supporting sentence in the light ink at 24px on up to three lines, max 26ch. Along the bottom runs the name in lowercase at clamp(120px, 12vw, 200px), light or regular weight, tracking -0.04em, on one line. It starts over the photograph's lower-right corner, overlapping the image by about 10% of the viewport width (z-index above it; mix-blend-mode: difference keeps the letters legible on the picture), and ends flush with the right margin, its baseline 40px above the bottom edge.
hero.mobile: The photograph takes the top 58% of the screen, inset 12px, with the same radius. The name runs under it at 21vw on one line, its ascenders overlapping the photograph's bottom edge by 3vw. The sentence follows at 17px, left-aligned on a 20px margin. Links reduce to a menu word and the action on the top row, set over the photograph.
hero.headline: The name in lowercase on one line, up to 9 characters at this size; a longer name drops to 9vw.

type.note: A heavy sans with tight joins and an eccentric lowercase, friendly but loud. Suits bookshops, food, consumer subscriptions and marketing studios.

palette.name: Sand and moss
palette.note: Sand grey holds the page with charcoal type, and one deep leaf-green band may close it. Moss green is reserved for buttons; brighter greens and blues arrive only through photographs.

motion.name: Scaling wordmark
motion.description: The giant name responds to the scroll: as the first screen leaves, the wordmark scales down a few percent (or grows from 0.94 to 1 as the footer arrives) on a scroll-linked timeline, so the monument feels heavy. Travel stays under 8%. Static fallback where scroll timelines are unsupported. Recipe: 'Scroll-linked progress' in references/motion.md, animating `scale`.

sections.name: Square plate, spare text
sections.blueprint: One flat field split 50/50, at least 88svh tall. Left half: a single square photograph filling the half's width minus 40px margins, vertically centred, square corners. A large simple shape may be laid over it to turn the photograph into the object it stands for: a ring 86% of its width with a 6px stroke and a small solid dot at the centre makes a record; a notch cut by clip-path makes a ticket stub. Right half, a flex column with space-between: at the top a row of three plain text tabs at 18px (editions, years, variants), the active one in full ink and the others at 40%; in the middle the title, two to four words at 32–40px bold, with a 34ch description 48px below; along the bottom two filled rectangular cells side by side, each half the column wide and 72px tall, acting as the two actions, one in ink and one a tone off the field.
sections.mobile: The square photograph comes first at full width with 16px margins. The tabs sit under it as one row at 17px. Then the title at 28px, the description, and the two action cells stacked, each full width and 60px tall.

sections.name: Giant word, filled bar rows
sections.blueprint: Sized for a reading column 520–640px wide, or centred at that width on a full page. The heading is one word (menu, hours, prices) in tall condensed capitals, its `font-size` set in container units (around 46cqw for four letters, tuned per word) so the letters fill the column from edge to edge, leading 0.8. 20px below, a stack of full-width filled bars, each 56px tall with 6px gaps, in a flat tone one step from the ground, with square corners or a 6px radius. Each bar carries a category name at 16px in medium weight at the left with 18px padding and a plus sign at the right. A bar opens in place as a `details` element: it keeps its fill, and its panel lists items at 16px, name left and price right-aligned with tabular figures, 14px between items, 20px padding. Six to nine bars; the first is open by default.
sections.mobile: The column is the full width with 16px margins, so the one-word heading spans the screen. Bars are 54px tall with 6px gaps and open the same way. Item descriptions, if any, sit under the name at 14px in the soft ink.

sections.name: Run-in column
sections.blueprint: The quietest sequence: one reading column and good typography. A single column 520–600px wide starts at about 30% of the viewport width (or sits on the page's text axis). The heading is a two-to-five-word question or statement at 28–32px, 48px above the first paragraph. Three to five paragraphs follow at 17–18px with line-height 1.6. Each opens with a bold run-in phrase in full ink that names its moment ('To begin,', 'Within a day,', 'After that,', 'From then on,') while the rest of the paragraph runs in the soft ink; there are no subheads, bullets or markers. After each paragraph, 20px lower, comes one small piece of evidence exactly as wide as the column: a cropped interface fragment, a photograph at 16:9, or a row of three small frames 96px tall. 72px separates stages. Nothing in the section is wider than the column, and the space to its left stays empty.
sections.mobile: The column fills the width between 20px margins. Type stays at 17px. Evidence pieces keep the column width; the row of three frames becomes a single sideways-scrolling row 88px tall. 56px between stages. The heading drops to 24px.

sections.name: Prices like a menu
sections.blueprint: Prices set the way a good menu sets them. A heading of two to three words at 32–40px sits in columns 1–3. Columns 5–12 hold the list in two text columns with a 64px gap. Items are grouped under plain group names at 24px in medium weight with 48px above each group. Each item is a row: the name at 19px on the left, the price at the same size on the right on the same baseline, with tabular figures and the currency sign shown only once per group; beneath the name, one line of description at 16px in the softer ink, no wider than 36ch. Rows are 22px apart. Name and price are joined only by empty space (flex with `justify-content: space-between`), with no dot leaders and no lines. One small photograph (4:5, three columns wide) may sit under the heading in the left zone.
sections.mobile: One column. The heading at 28px, then the photograph at 60% width if used. Each item keeps name left and price right on one line at 17px, with its description beneath in the softer ink. Group names at 20px with 40px above.

sections.name: Founder's letter
sections.blueprint: A letter in a centred column 520px wide with at least 160px of empty ground above and below. At the column's top-left, a round portrait 44px across. 28px below it, four or five short paragraphs at 16–17px with leading 1.55, each two to four lines and separated by one blank line, written in the first person. No heading. The sign-off is the writer's name at 22px in the text face's italic, with the role at 14px in the soft ink beneath it. One phrase in the letter may carry a flat marker-colour background. Variant for a page built as an object: the letter sits on a filled paper-colour sheet 640px wide with 60px padding on a contrasting ground, square corners, its bottom edge cut into small scallops with `clip-path`, and below a row of 5px round dots a tear-off strip 72px tall that carries the email address.
sections.mobile: The column takes the full width with 24px margins; text at 16px, portrait 40px. In the sheet variant the sheet spans edge to edge with 24px padding and keeps its shaped bottom edge; the tear-off strip stacks the email above a full-width button.

sections.name: Wide heading, indented questions
sections.blueprint: A heading of three to five words at about 5.5vw runs from the left margin on one or two lines and is the only large thing in the section. 80px beneath it the questions begin, indented to start at column 5 and running to column 12, so the left third under the heading stays empty. Each question is a row at 22–24px in the regular weight with a chevron of two 2px strokes at the far right; rows are separated by 36px of space and no rules. Opening a row lays a tile of the one-step tone behind that row and its answer (24px padding, extending 24px beyond the text on both sides) and shows the answer at 17px with a 48ch measure. Six questions. Nothing else shares the screen; the indent against the wide heading is the composition. Build with `<details>`.
sections.mobile: The heading sits at 10vw on two lines. Questions lose the indent and run full width at 19px with 28px between rows; the open row keeps its tone tile, now bleeding to both screen edges, with the answer at 16px inside it.

sections.name: Clip-out coupon form
sections.blueprint: The form is a coupon to cut out. One filled card in a strong flat colour, about 2.2:1, spans columns 2–11 with a 14px radius, with 120px of ground above and below. Semicircular notches 28px across are cut into its top and bottom edges at the 46% mark with `clip-path` or an SVG `mask`, and a vertical row of round dots (a dotted `border-left` 5px thick in the ground colour) joins the two notches as the perforation. Left of the perforation, with 48px padding: a two-line heading of three to five words at clamp(28px, 3vw, 44px) in heavy capitals at the top, and one sentence at 16px at the bottom. Right of it: four inputs stacked with 10px gaps, each a filled block 52px tall in a lighter tone of the card with its placeholder at 16px, then a full-width solid submit bar 56px tall in the darkest ink. Inputs keep visually hidden `label` elements.
sections.mobile: The card turns upright and spans the width with 12px margins. The perforation becomes horizontal: notches on the left and right edges, dots across. Heading and sentence sit above it; the four inputs and the submit bar sit below, each 54px tall.

sections.name: Name first, places under it
sections.blueprint: The wordmark opens the footer instead of closing it. On a full-bleed field in the page's inverse or final chapter colour, the name spans the full content width as the first thing, its cap line pushed 8% above the footer's top edge so the tops of the letters are sliced off by the section (`overflow: hidden` and a negative top margin in `em`). 72px beneath, a two-part row: columns 1–5 list the places or ways to reach the studio (cities, or email and telephone), one per line at 32–36px in the accent ink, each a link; columns 7–12 hold three columns of small links at 15px, top-aligned with the first place. A final row 96px lower carries the legal line at the left and a back-to-top text link at the right, both 13px. The field is about 90svh tall, and nothing sits between the wordmark and the row but space.
sections.mobile: The sliced wordmark stays at the top, fitted to the width. Places follow as a list at 26px, then the link columns two across at 15px. Legal line and back-to-top link share the last row at 12px, at opposite margins.

references.name: Kereliott
references.idea: A quiet house gets a quiet page: one dark field, one typeface, the name set as wide as the screen and photographs left to drift in generous darkness.
references.hero: Very dark green-black field with cream type. A two-line introductory sentence at about 30px sits top-left inside 30px margins; a small cream rectangular button sits top-right. The upper half is otherwise empty. The house name fills the full content width in a flared humanist sans, mixed case, with capitals about 19vw tall, its baseline at roughly 87% of the viewport height. Immediately beneath, separated by a gap of a few pixels, the top sliver of a full-width landscape photograph enters from the bottom edge.
references.type: A single face, Trust, in regular weight: a humanist sans with flared terminals and old-style figures. The wordmark is an oversized graphic; all other text is one size of about 20-30px plus tiny 10px photo captions. Hierarchy is position, not weight.
references.colour: #161c1a #eae8dc #222926 #1f2926 — Cream on green-black from top to bottom with no accent colour. The map is drawn in a tone barely lighter than the ground, so photographs supply all the colour.
references.imagery: Natural-light photos of a stone cottage, garden and deck with square corners, in mixed portrait and landscape crops at differing sizes. One full-width opener, then small images placed singly with tiny captions under the left corner.
references.layout: 30px margins, text held to the left 60% in one size. Photographs are staggered left and right at different widths with large dark gaps between, like pictures passed on a wall. The name and a booking button stay fixed in the top corners.

sections.description: A full-width landscape photograph runs margin to margin directly under the wordmark, followed after a gap by a four-line paragraph in the single text size, left-aligned and spanning about 85% of the width. There is no heading or label; the text simply continues the sentence begun at the top of the page.

After a left-aligned paragraph, a silhouette map of the region sits centre-left, about half the viewport wide, filled in a green only a few percent lighter than the background. Five towns are marked with small ring dots and tiny labels; only the house's town has a solid cream dot. No border, legend or frame.

Photographs are placed one or two per screen in a stagger: a portrait image about 30% wide against the left margin, a larger near-square one starting lower against the right margin, later a landscape image top-right of centre and a smaller one bottom-left. Each has a 10px caption under its left corner. More than half of every screen is empty dark ground.

Two short left-aligned sentences in the standard text size with underlined inline links to booking platforms and an email address, then a small cream certification badge. The footer is a single line at the very bottom: social link left, copyright centre, three underlined utility links right, with a tall empty gap above.

steal: Size the wordmark to fill the content width exactly and let the first photograph tuck directly under its baseline.
Draw a location map as a tone-on-tone silhouette with one filled dot among ring dots.
Use a single typeface in one weight and essentially one text size, creating hierarchy through placement and emptiness.

references.name: Nia Creative
references.idea: The three-letter wordmark becomes a slot-machine reel: the name repeats vertically and its middle letter is swapped for a square of client photography or video.
references.hero: Pale grey field with a slim nav: bracketed lowercase logo top-left, four uppercase mono links centred, a black pill button top-right. The centre 43% of the width holds a vertical reel of the wordmark stacked three times in very heavy black grotesk, each row about 230px tall; in every row the middle letter is replaced by a square photo or video tile (surfers, a woman holding glasses over her eyes, a burger). The middle row is sharp; rows above and below fade out through gradient masks. A bottom strip carries a mono descriptor at left and city plus live clock at right. A plum band starts at the fold.
references.type: A heavy, tightly tracked grotesk (xgnl) carries the wordmark, a 70px lowercase section word and bold 20 to 34px statements; body is the same face at 14px, bold. Geist Mono in small capitals handles nav, categories, bracketed indexes and the clock.
references.colour: #f3f3f3 #574d56 #515144 #1c1c1c #b9aebd #b3b586 — Pale grey base with black type. Two muted full-width bands, dusty plum and olive, set their text in a lighter tint of the band colour rather than white. Photography supplies the saturation.
references.imagery: Flash-lit hospitality and lifestyle photography plus short video: cocktails, hotel rooms, food, trail runners. Portrait tiles with one or two large rounded corners, square tiles inside the wordmark, and an edge-to-edge three-up strip.
references.layout: 28px side margins and a three-column grid for work. Big lowercase section words sit flush left with a small paragraph flush right. Sections alternate pale grey grids, coloured statement bands and full-bleed image strips; a black rounded nav bar pins to the top after the hero.

sections.description: Dusty plum band about one viewport tall. A bold 34px statement in pale lilac sits top-left across half the width, one phrase underlined with a hand-drawn stroke. Lower left, a small heading and eight industries in tiny uppercase mono split into two bulleted columns. At the right margin a tall portrait photo, about 20% of the width, with large rounded corners, overlaps the band's top edge and leaves the middle of the band empty.

A 70px heavy lowercase word flush left with a three-line 14px paragraph flush right on the same baseline. Below, three equal columns with wide gutters: each has a portrait image narrower than its column with a large radius on the bottom-right corner only, then a 20px project name, a mono uppercase category and a four-line bold description. Rows repeat with no dividers or card backgrounds.

Three photographs or clips butt together edge to edge with no gaps, each a third of the viewport wide and about 40% of a screen tall. Immediately below, an olive band: a three-line 26px statement in pale olive at left with one underlined phrase, two lines of small copy beneath it, and a small rounded portrait image tucked into the lower right corner.

Services as stacked sheets. Each is a full-width panel with a 1px outline and large top-corner radius that slides up over the previous one. The left half is empty except for a centred column: a bracketed mono index, a 26px bold title and four centred lines of sub-services. The right half is one photograph with rounded corners filling the panel height.

steal: Drop a photo tile into the wordmark in place of one letter and run the lockup as a vertical reel with masked top and bottom rows.
On coloured bands, set type in a lighter tint of the band's own hue instead of white to keep the band calm.
Round only one corner of each image tile, the same corner every time, as a quiet signature shape.

references.name: Kononenko Architectural Bureau
references.idea: Let the renders do the talking: one full-bleed visualisation, a name set half in grotesk and half in serif, then alternating oversized sans and serif statements on white.
references.hero: A single architectural render fills the viewport edge to edge: a low grey metal-clad building under a large overcast sky, wild grass across the bottom third. Type is white and tiny except for the name. Top-left at a 24px margin, the bureau name is stacked on three lines at 13px. Top-right, four links run inline separated by commas, the current one underlined. Bottom-left, the name repeats at 60px (4.2vw) on two tight lines, the first two words in grotesk and the last word in a serif at the same size. No button, no scrim, no tagline; the sky takes the upper 45% untouched.
references.type: Two faces (digest names are obfuscated): a tight neo-grotesk at −0.03em and a soft high-contrast serif, mixed inside one line in the name. Section statements alternate: centred sans at about 6.5vw, then left-aligned serif at 4.5vw with a first-line indent. Labels are 9px.
references.colour: #ffffff #000000 #b7b7b9 #7c8050 #3d3a36 #9a9a9a — White pages with black type; colour comes only from the renders' overcast greys, greens and dark timber. The footer inverts to solid black with white letters.
references.imagery: Photoreal architectural visualisations in muted natural light, shown full-bleed at wide panoramic crops with square corners and no overlays; one loose black ink sketch on white stands in for process.
references.layout: 24px outer margins. Full-bleed image bands alternate with white type-only screens. Big statements either centre or run the full width; small data sits in narrow columns with tiny serif labels left of sans values, and hairline tables are inset to the right-hand third.

sections.description: White screen with a two-line sans heading centred at roughly 6.5vw, tight leading, taking the top third. Directly beneath, two tiny grey captions of two lines each sit side by side, each about 130px wide, centred as a pair. A full-bleed panoramic render starts immediately below and runs off the bottom, so the heading reads as a caption to the picture.

Far left, three label and value pairs at 9px (serif label, sans value) stack in a 150px column. From 34% across, a five-line serif paragraph at about 22px runs to 90% of the width. 120px lower a second row repeats the logic for achievements: a label at far left, then two narrow list columns of awards and publications at 9px with generous gaps between them.

A four-line serif statement at 4.5vw spans the full width, left-aligned with the first line indented about 3% and leading under 1. Below it, pushed into the right-hand 35% of the page, an offices table: a tiny label hangs to its left, and each row holds office type, country and city in grey, an address, and a small arrow, divided by hairlines at 18px row height.

Solid black. A top band of five tiny columns (name, navigation, media, address, hours), each a grey label beside a white list. Then a four-letter abbreviation of the name in white grotesk fills the entire width, letters about 45% of the viewport tall and touching both edges, with a single 8px legal line squeezed beneath.

steal: Set the last word of a sans headline in an upright serif of the same size to give a plain name a signature without any graphic device.
Alternate statement voices down the page: a centred grotesk heading, then a full-width left-aligned serif paragraph at display size with a first-line indent.
Close with an abbreviation of the name scaled until it touches both edges of a black footer, with all practical links shrunk to 9px above it.
